source_identity.art: Selected local CZ 2015 client asset set
source_identity.widget_reference: ui.py from the local original-client reference source
source_identity.source_match_limit: Art and hashes are exact; portable egui layout recipes are reconstructed from available widget sources, not a claim of pixel-exact full native runtime parity.
source_identity.ownership: Original game art and font designs retain their existing ownership; this export does not grant a new asset license.
source_identity.pixel_policy: Original decoded RGBA pixels only. No generated substitute art, resampling or color changes in asset regions. Exact duplicate pixels share atlas storage.

application_variants: Wide buttons preserve native-height end caps and tile their center. Disabled sprites are dimmed by the application. One fixed Metin appearance; original RGBA artwork remains unchanged. Unknown mounting adds a question mark as text. Class skill art uses only original base grade images and is presentation-only.
